candidates.tagline: Trump International Airport's new logo looks like AI hallucinated a bald eagle.
candidates.story: Palm Beach airport was renamed Donald J. Trump International Airport in July 2026, but the grand new welcome-sign logo appears to be AI-generated — the eagle has deformed talons of different shapes, wings with mismatched feather counts, and only 11 stripes on its shield instead of the correct 13.
candidates.why_funny: They renamed an entire international airport and put a giant sign out front, then apparently asked an AI for the logo and didn't look too closely at the talons.
candidates.alt: Annotated diagram of the Trump International Airport eagle logo with arrows pointing out deformed mismatched talons, unequal wing feathers, and wrong number of shield stripes

candidates.tagline: You paid $300 for hearing-boost smart glasses. Meta now charges $20/month to keep using the boost.
candidates.story: Meta quietly put 'Conversation Focus' — the hearing-amplification feature on its Ray-Ban smart glasses — behind a $20/month subscription in July 2026, giving existing owners just 3 free hours a month before the feature shuts off, angering buyers who say they should not rent hardware they already own.
candidates.why_funny: The key feature that justified buying expensive AI glasses is now a subscription on top of the glasses you already bought — like an airline charging extra to recline a seat you're already sitting in.
candidates.alt: Ray-Ban Meta Gen 1 smart glasses resting next to their compact charging case on a white surface
